title: Error codes agree for a missing slice
lead: `ops.edit_section` refuses an item without a slice with the code `no_slice`, as `edit_boundary` and `edit_lead` already do, and the migrator catches only slicer's own errors when it maps a status label.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** auditing every other `StateError` for a more specific code; `Config.status_for_label` raising `ConfigError` (exit 3) for a user label.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: AGENTS.md says the error code is the contract. The same condition, "ID has no slice", raises `state` from `ops.edit_section` (`src/slicer/ops.py:1880`) but `no_slice` from `ops.edit_boundary` and `ops.edit_lead` (`src/slicer/ops.py:2013`, `src/slicer/ops.py:2025`). The CLI pre-checks with `no_slice`, so only callers that reach `ops` directly, such as the TUI, see `state`. Separately, the migrator maps each status cell with `cfg.status_for_label` inside `except Exception` (`src/slicer/migrator.py:253-256`); that catch would also turn a real bug into a reported problem. Found by the Go rewrite evaluation (`research/go-rewrite-evaluation.md`).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/ops.py`, `edit_section`: pass `code="no_slice"`, as the two siblings do.
- `src/slicer/migrator.py`: catch `SlicerError` instead of `Exception`.
- `docs/agents.md`, the error-code table: one sentence saying when a refusal uses the plain `state` code and when it takes a specific one (a specific code exists for the condition).
- `CHANGELOG.md` under Changed (the code a direct `edit_section` caller sees).
- Tests beside the existing `edit` and migrator tests.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_EditSection_NoSlice_CodeIsNoSlice`: `ops.edit_section` on an item with no slice raises a `StateError` whose `code` is `no_slice`.
- `test_Migrate_StatusLabelBug_NotSwallowed`: with `status_for_label` patched to raise a `RuntimeError`, the migrator lets it propagate instead of reporting it as a problem.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. Add the code and narrow the catch.
3. Docs and CHANGELOG; mutation-check (drop the code; widen the catch again).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `python3.12 -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests` passes.
- `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
